description: Convert a file from a public URL to another format, e.g. OFD→PDF, HEIC→JPG, STEP→STL, WEM→MP3, DOCX→PDF. Downloads the file, converts it, and returns a download link (valid ~4 hours). Most conversions finish within the call; if not, the result has status "processing" and a job_id for get_conversion_status. The file must be reachable over the internet; up to 50 MB.

file_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the file to convert. Google Drive and Dropbox share links work.

filename.description: Name for the file, with extension, e.g. "invoice.ofd". Optional.

from.description: Source format extension. Only needed when the URL and filename do not end in one.

name: convert_file
title: Convert a file
